title_en: Roblox Studio Just Got an AI That Writes Scripts For You!
title_ua: У Roblox Studio з'явився ШІ, який пише скрипти за тебе!
tg_post_en: 🤖 Roblox Studio just got an AI brain — and it's WILD! Guys, Studio now has AI tools that write scripts, generate textures, AND auto-rig your avatars for you. 🎮 No more staring at empty code for hours! I tested everything and made a beginner-friendly guide so you can start building your first game today. Free templates included! ✨ #Roblox #Guide #Building
